section.heading: Power of State Government to empower officer in charge to discharge
section.html:
The State Government may empower the officer in charge of the jail in which a person is confined under the provisions of section 330.

or section 335 to discharge all or any of the functions of the Inspector-General of Prisons under section 337 or section 338.
section.text: The State Government may empower the officer in charge of the jail in which a person is confined under the provisions of section 330. or section 335 to discharge all or any of the functions of the Inspector-General of Prisons under section 337 or section 338.
